company_name: Shaoxing Hongbang Electronics Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical equipment and services for semiconductor manufacturing, including device handling and test systems.
summary: Shaoxing Hongbang Electronics Technology Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing equipment and services for the semiconductor industry. Their product lines include device handling systems such as feeding systems, die sorters, and pick & place systems, as well as flip chip placement systems. They also offer test systems for mixed signal and discrete components, along with manufacturing services and consulting to improve operational efficiency.
capabilities: Device handling systems including feeding systems and die sorters
Mixed signal and discrete component test systems
Static and ESD testing and control services
